description: This file defines the HandlerStack class within the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for creating and managing a stack of middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses. It primarily constructs a chain of middlewares that are executed in sequence to process HTTP interactions.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: A class that manages a stack of middleware functions which, when combined, form a handler for executing HTTP requests with various processing layers such as retries, redirects, cookies, and error handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default HandlerStack instance preconfigured with middleware for error handling, redirects, cookies, and request body preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HandlerStack with an optional underlying handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the HandlerStack instance to be invoked as a function, executing the composed handler with a request and options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets or replaces the underlying HTTP handler responsible for sending the request.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler has been assigned to the stack.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds a middleware function to the bottom of the middleware stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a middleware function to the top of the middleware stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts a middleware before another specified middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts a middleware after another specified middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a middleware from the stack by instance or by name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Composes all middlewares and the handler into a single callable to handle requests.
